PRIVATE BETA HELP

A little help getting started

A link, a quality, a file for later. Here is what to do at each step.

Join and sign in

Open your invitation, use the invited email address and choose a password of 12–128 characters. Verify your email when asked. Recovery and verification links work once; request another if a link expires. Recover your account.

Prepare a download

  1. Paste a supported YouTube video link and select Find video.
  2. Choose Video or Audio and a quality returned for that link.
  3. Select Prepare download. Watch the reported progress, then choose Save to device.

Requests can wait for a worker. You can cancel checking a video or preparing a file. Your collection and allowance are tied to your account. Files normally expire after 30 minutes; history does not keep a permanent copy of the media.

When something fails

Check your sign-in state and daily allowance, then try again after the displayed error clears. An expired file needs a new request. If the source is unavailable or access is restricted, use an option provided by the source platform. Do not send passwords, session cookies, verification links, signed file links or other people’s private videos to support.

Contact and reports

For this private beta, contact the person who invited you through the same channel. Include the approximate time, visible error, browser and device, plus a request ID if shown. For a rights or abuse report, include the affected content identifier and a description of your concern without sharing credentials. A public support address and response commitment will be added before public registration opens.

Your account

Export data, recover access or close your account. The privacy notice explains deletion and retention.

Only download content with the required authorization. Private beta · 22 October 2026.
